_comment: #396 winter_teeth_fight's start: NIGHT, at the shepherd. Two deliberate departures from winter_teeth_start. (1) actions_since_sleep 1000 puts the save past moods.json's night_at 900, so river_wolf_pack's encounter_when is armed on arrival -- the established night-fixture pattern (boulevard_night_footpads_start, invrisil_hat_loud_start, feel_peek_night_start all do this) and the reason this script needs none of riverfarm_fight's 940-interact burst to reach night. (2) BAND FIXTURE: the GEARED t3_warrior10 reference build (warrior 10, melee_hit 57 for the L10 requires, gnollish_hunting_knife + leather_jerkin + hedge_ward_charm + hunters_fang_talisman), copied from invrisil_setting_fight_start, because river_wolf_pack is measured at t3_warrior10 in sim_combat_batch's river_wolf_pack_t3_hunter cell -- warrior5+mage5 has no cell there at all. Sums to 10, so its COMBAT_BAND_FIXTURES row is 10. heard_winter_teeth and hunter_will_come both UNBANKED: the script earns the offer and the watch ask live, which is the only thing that fields the shepherd in the fight. TRAP: rng_state is DERIVED (tests/_derive_rng_state.gd), never hand-typed; WISave restores .state directly and RNG_STATE_MIN_MAGNITUDE rejects small ints.
